title: Bootsie Galbraith sees a UFO called in by Steven Greer

tellings.quote: She was in Mexico with Steven Greer and he called in a UFO and they all saw it.

plain: A woman named Bootsie Galbraith was in Mexico in the 1990s with Steven Greer, a campaigner who says people can summon UFOs through meditation, when Greer "called in a UFO and they all saw it." The writer Whitley Strieber, known for his own accounts of meeting strange beings, tells Michels this as what Galbraith told him. If true, it would mean such craft can be called on purpose.
